featured_reviews.review_text: Blood donation is a safe, quick (approx. 10-minute draw), and highly rewarding experience that saves lives. featured_reviews.name: Nitesh Solkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Such a positive experience today at Sion blood bank. I donate blood to this blood bank every year. I felt cared for from start to finish. Thank you for the wonderful service!"

featured_reviews.name: Sid The Explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had visited here for voluntary blood donation. The experience was very good as the staff were courteous and professional.
During the donation I felt a bit uneasy, and the staff handled it promptly and calmly.
After the donation, they offered Frooti and provided a certificate, donor card, and a bottle as a memento, which felt thoughtful. Since I was not feeling fully normal, they also asked me to wait at reception for a few minutes and leave only after I felt completely fine.
The place is well maintained and is only a 5 to 7 minute walk from Goregaon West railway station. I would definitely recommend it for blood donation.

featured_reviews.name: Shivani Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
My colleague had an opportunity to volunteer for blood donation at Meenatai Thackeray Blood Bank, and it was an excellent experience. The facility was exceptionally clean and maintained high standards of hygiene, which made the process very reassuring. The doctors and staff were professional, approachable, and ensured everything was well-organized and comfortable for donors.
Highly recommended for anyone considering blood donation!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Went on 21st May 2021 for my father's 1st dose of Covishield vaccine.

Excellent arrangements and the place was properly maintained as per Covid norms. The staff was very friendly and helpful.

We took the afternoon slot, so it was less crowded. People with prior appointments were only taken in, so that might be also a reason for less crowd.

The place is #wheelchairaccessible on entrance and the lift. Recommended for Goregaonkars who would like a less crowded place for vaccination during this Corona phase.

featured_reviews.name: jay sanghavi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: Disappointed with Lack of Discounts for Regular Blood Donations

Review:

I have been an active blood donor for several years, and I have participated in numerous blood donation camps organized by various organizations. While I appreciate the efforts made by ANVISHKA (GHATKOPAR WEST MUMBAI ) in collecting and distributing blood, I am deeply disappointed by the lack of recognition and benefits given to regular donors like myself.

Throughout the years, I have diligently donated my blood, always carrying my proof cards as evidence of my contributions. However, despite my consistent efforts, I have never received any discounts on blood when I required it during my own medical emergencies. I find this disheartening, as it seems that ANVISHKA does not value the loyalty and dedication of the blood donors

It is not unreasonable to expect some form of acknowledgment or incentive for those of us who selflessly give our blood to help others. Other blood banks and organizations often provide discounts or priority access to regular donors, recognizing their commitment and encouraging them to continue their vital contributions.

I sincerely hope that ANVISHKA takes this feedback into consideration and reevaluates their policies regarding discounts for regular blood donors. Acknowledging and rewarding the generosity of individuals who consistently support their cause would not only foster a stronger bond with the donor community but also motivate others to become regular blood donors.

I still believe in the importance of blood donation and will continue to contribute to the cause, but I hope ANVISHKA reconsiders their stance on recognizing the dedication of their regular donors.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Tawde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently donated blood at this blood bank and was informed that my blood had tested positive for hepatitis C antibodies using the ELISA Generation 4 method. Naturally, this news was extremely concerning, so I took it upon myself to get retested at a private lab. The private lab conducted two tests—one using the rapid method and the other using the ELFA method. Both of these tests came back negative for hepatitis C antibodies. To be absolutely sure, I also did an HCV RNA PCR test, which is the most reliable test for detecting an active hepatitis C infection. Thankfully, the result was "NOT DETECTED," meaning there was no active virus in my blood.

This whole experience has caused me unnecessary stress and confusion. I fully understand that antibody tests can sometimes give false positives, but I believe the blood bank should be more cautious and thorough before alarming donors with such serious results. Furthermore, after receiving the initial notification, I reached out to the blood bank multiple times seeking guidance on what to do next, but they have stopped responding to my queries. They haven’t provided any further support, leaving me in the dark about whether I can donate blood in the future or what steps I should take.

This lack of communication and support from the blood bank is extremely disappointing, especially when dealing with such sensitive health concerns. I advise others to be cautious and double-check their results if they receive any alarming notifications from this blood bank. I hope the blood bank improves their processes, both in terms of accuracy and in providing proper guidance to donors.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
BloodLine - Thane’s very own advanced blood bank. Blood Line has charted out a plan to help the needy, people who otherwise find it difficult to source blood and pay for it during an emergency. They have worked out rates that are affordable to such sections of the society. BloodLine is a non-profit organization activity involved in the betterment of the society through its high-tech yet accessible blood bank.
They are also recognised by Government of Maharashtra & State Blood Transfusion Council by giving RBTC (Regional Blood Transfusion Centre) status to Bloodline Thane.
BloodLine is the first Blood Bank in Maharashtra which is having ISO 9001:2008 Certification.
Bloodline is the only NGO run bloodbank in Konkan Division having NACO Assistance given by Ministry og Health and Family Welfare Govt. of  India, ISO Certification and Regional Blood Center Status.
